integrity: All finite verification was recomputed using the embedded standalone exact-rational checker. The infinite law rests on a self-contained analytic moment proof. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniformly random complete strict student rankings and square one-to-one markets are essential.
School priorities are exogenous strict profiles; correlated rankings and unequal capacities are not covered.
The known coupon formula and harmonic mean are credited as prior work.
Unindexed publication-priority risk and absent independent scientific review remain.
title: A full-law coupling of unenvied counts in random matching mechanisms
